# Swift Pieces

> Swift Pieces (swiftpieces.com) is a free library of 55 SwiftUI components for iOS in 14 categories: animated, gesture-driven interactions such as a swipeable card stack, Liquid Glass (iOS 26) menus, a floating tab bar, interactive charts, form inputs and AI chat surfaces. Each piece is one self-contained Swift file (plus a .metal file where a shader is involved) on Apple frameworks only, from iOS 17. Install by copy-paste, `npx swiftpieces add <Name>`, or the Swift Pieces MCP server.

Key facts:

- License: MIT + Commons Clause. Free for personal and commercial apps, including client work. Source-available rather than OSI open source: the pieces themselves may not be sold or redistributed.
- No dependencies and no Swift package: the CLI copies source files into a SwiftPieces folder in the app, and they become the developer's own code.
- iOS 17 baseline. Liquid Glass pieces gate glass with `#available(iOS 26, *)` and fall back to Material.
- Motion, states and accessibility are built in (Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency), with haptics (sensoryFeedback) where an interaction calls for them.
- Source: https://github.com/Saivion/SwiftPieces

Rules for Liquid Glass: gate with `#available(iOS 26, *)` and a Material fallback; wrap multiple glass views in one `GlassEffectContainer`; apply `.glassEffect` after layout modifiers; respect `accessibilityReduceTransparency`; never use invented modifiers such as `.liquidGlassUltra`.

## Guides

- [SwiftUI Animations: A Practical Guide with Examples](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-animations): SwiftUI animations explained with working examples: implicit and explicit animation, spring animation, transitions, keyframe animators, and gestures.
- [SwiftUI Buttons: Custom Styles, Animation, Loading](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-buttons): SwiftUI buttons from the basics to custom ButtonStyle, press animation, haptics, async loading states, hold to confirm, and accessible hit targets.
- [SwiftUI Cards: Card Views, Swipe Stacks and Flip Cards](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-cards): Build SwiftUI cards that feel native: continuous corners, layered shadows, press states, a swipeable card stack, a 3D flip card, tilt and scroll parallax.
- [SwiftUI Haptics: sensoryFeedback and Haptic Feedback](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-haptics): A practical guide to SwiftUI haptics: sensoryFeedback triggers, conditions and feedback kinds, drag threshold ticks, UIKit generators, and restraint.
- [SwiftUI Skeleton Loading, Shimmer and Loading States](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/guides/swiftui-loading-states): SwiftUI skeleton loading with redacted placeholders, a shimmer modifier, ProgressView styles, success and failure morphs, paging footers and Reduce Motion.

## Collections

- [SwiftUI text effects](https://swiftpieces.com/components/text): Free SwiftUI text effects for iOS: animated text reveal with highlights, Liquid Glass text and expandable Read more text. One Swift file each, no dependencies. (3 pieces)
- [SwiftUI animated backgrounds](https://swiftpieces.com/components/backgrounds): Free animated SwiftUI backgrounds for iOS: a Metal shader silk surface with device-tilt lighting and an interactive Canvas dot grid with haptics. (2 pieces)
- [SwiftUI Liquid Glass components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/glass): Free SwiftUI Liquid Glass components for iOS 26: glass surface, segmented control and floating action menu, each with a Material fallback for iOS 17. (3 pieces)
- [SwiftUI buttons and controls](https://swiftpieces.com/components/controls): Free custom SwiftUI buttons and controls for iOS: animated button styles, an async loading button, hold to confirm, a timer dial and more. With haptics. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI input fields and form controls](https://swiftpieces.com/components/inputs): Free SwiftUI inputs for iOS: floating label text field, password strength field, currency amount field, token field, date range picker and range slider. (9 pieces)
- [SwiftUI cards](https://swiftpieces.com/components/cards): Free SwiftUI card components for iOS: a swipeable card stack, 3D flip card, device-tilt motion card and parallax image card. One file each, with haptics. (4 pieces)
- [SwiftUI lists and carousels](https://swiftpieces.com/components/lists): Free SwiftUI list components for iOS: custom swipe action rows, a swipeable task row, status timeline, depth paging carousel and an infinite scroll list. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI navigation components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/navigation): Free SwiftUI navigation components for iOS: a floating tab bar dock, paging tabs with a scroll-tracking indicator and a stretchy header that pins to the nav bar. (3 pieces)
- [SwiftUI sheets and toasts](https://swiftpieces.com/components/sheets): Free SwiftUI sheet components for iOS: a confirmation bottom sheet, a pre-permission request sheet and a toast notification with undo. Haptics included. (3 pieces)
- [SwiftUI feedback and loading states](https://swiftpieces.com/components/feedback): Free SwiftUI feedback components for iOS: skeleton loading with shimmer, loading to success checkmark animation, success and error screens, like button, star rating. (5 pieces)
- [SwiftUI gesture and motion modifiers](https://swiftpieces.com/components/motion): Free SwiftUI motion modifiers for iOS: drag to dismiss for photos, cards and sheets, with velocity-based springs, a styled scrim, haptics and Reduce Motion. (1 pieces)
- [SwiftUI charts and data components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/data): Free SwiftUI data components for iOS: an interactive line and bar chart, scrubbable donut chart, rolling odometer number animation and KPI stat tiles. (4 pieces)
- [SwiftUI AI chat components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/ai): Free SwiftUI AI chat components for iOS: streaming text reply, thinking indicator, prompt suggestion chips, code block with syntax colors and Metal shader orbs. (6 pieces)
- [SwiftUI photo and media components](https://swiftpieces.com/components/media): Free SwiftUI media components for iOS: a full-screen photo viewer with pinch to zoom, double-tap zoom and drag to dismiss, and a Stories progress bar. (2 pieces)
- [SwiftUI animations](https://swiftpieces.com/components/animations): Free animated SwiftUI components for iOS: card stacks, 3D flips, text reveals, rolling numbers, loading morphs and spring buttons. One Swift file each. (16 pieces)
- [SwiftUI components with haptic feedback](https://swiftpieces.com/components/haptics): Free SwiftUI components with haptic feedback built in: buttons, sliders, dials, ratings, sheets and gestures that tick, tap and confirm with sensoryFeedback. (19 pieces)

## Swift Pieces Pro

A separate paid library for building whole apps: 48 screens, 10 app templates and a 24-item Build Kit (production-ready SwiftUI screens, complete Xcode projects, and agent skills that build the rest in the same design) at https://pro.swiftpieces.com/library. One plan with lifetime access; plan and pricing: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/pro. Pro MCP endpoint: https://pro.swiftpieces.com/api/mcp (license key required): search_library, get_item, list_kit, get_kit_item, apply_design_skill, apply_recipe.

## AI (https://swiftpieces.com/components/ai)

- [Assistant Orb](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/assistant-orb): A dark glass ball with a Siri-style voice wave inside, locked to the thinking state; four thin sine membranes travel through the equator of a refracting shell, drawn by a Metal color shader. The sphere never moves, only the wave, and a palette change crossfades its colours. (iOS 17.0+, Metal). Install: `npx swiftpieces add AssistantOrb`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/AssistantOrb.json
- [Code Block](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/code-block): A code slab for chat replies and docs that stays dark in both appearances: a butter language label and optional filename, block-colored Swift syntax, collapse past N lines with a fade and a spring expand, wrap toggle, text selection, a streaming mode that fades lines in behind a cursor, and a copy pill that turns into a sage Copied block. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add CodeBlock`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/CodeBlock.json
- [Prompt Chips](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/prompt-chips): A snapping horizontal row of prompt suggestions above a composer, each chip keyed by a solid color block glyph. The chosen chip morphs into a composer-width block with matchedGeometryEffect while the rest slide out, then the row hands the text back and collapses. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add PromptChips`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/PromptChips.json
- [Streaming Reply](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/streaming-reply): The AI reply surface. A small header carries the assistant mark and a live phase label, text arrives token by token with a per-word fade and a color block cursor, inline code sits on butter blocks, user prompts are solid color blocks, and a long press lifts the message to reveal copy and regenerate. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add StreamingReply`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/StreamingReply.json
- [Thinking State](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/thinking-state): The "assistant is working" placeholder, laid out like the reply it becomes: a breathing mark with an elapsed-seconds label over three presentations on one clock: block-colored rising dots, a sheen over reply-shaped bars, or a label whose glyphs carry the sheen. Plus a modifier that sweeps any view. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ThinkingState`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ThinkingState.json
- [Thought Orb](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/ai/thought-orb): A small dark glass ball with a Siri-style voice wave inside, locked to the thinking state and drawn by a Metal color shader; palettes for searching, reading and writing crossfade the colour with the kind of work, and a Pill wraps it with a label and indeterminate dots into the status control. (iOS 17.0+, Metal). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ThoughtOrb`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ThoughtOrb.json

## Backgrounds (https://swiftpieces.com/components/backgrounds)

- [Silk](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/backgrounds/silk): A slowly folding silk surface lit by a movable light and shaded from a real gradient normal in a Metal shader, in house block fabrics and an adaptive standard style, with optional device-tilt lighting. (iOS 17.0+, Metal). Install: `npx swiftpieces add Silk`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/Silk.json
- [Touch Grid](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/backgrounds/touch-grid): A Canvas dot grid that swells and warms into a house block color under the finger, springs back on release, and sends one dissipating ripple out from a tap. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TouchGrid`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TouchGrid.json

## Cards (https://swiftpieces.com/components/cards)

- [Flip Card](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/cards/flip-card): A two-sided card you flip by tap or by dragging sideways. The drag scrubs the rotation, release commits or snaps back by velocity, the card lifts toward you mid-turn with a layered shadow that slides off the raised edge, and each face shades as it turns edge-on. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add FlipCard`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/FlipCard.json
- [Motion Card](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/cards/motion-card): A solid color card that tilts with the device's attitude through an exponential filter, with a fixed-light sheen and a layered shadow that slide as it turns. Press settles it flat and scales it down with a light impact, and Core Motion stops whenever the scene is not active. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add MotionCard`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/MotionCard.json
- [Parallax Card](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/cards/parallax-card): An image card whose picture drifts slower than the scroll while a solid caption block drifts slower still, so the card reads in layers. Press lifts it with a deeper shadow and nudges the trailing glyph, and the caption is composed from eyebrow, title, metadata, and trailing glyph slots. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ParallaxCard`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ParallaxCard.json
- [Swipe Deck](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/cards/swipe-deck): A gesture-driven card stack: the top card follows the finger and swings from its base, a solid outcome badge fades in for the direction you are heading and locks at the threshold, the cards beneath rise as it leaves, and release past the threshold or a flick throws it left, right, or up. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SwipeDeck`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SwipeDeck.json

## Controls (https://swiftpieces.com/components/controls)

- [Commit Button](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/controls/commit-button): An async action button driven by one idle/loading/success/error/disabled phase: a signal capsule collapses to a spinning ring, closes it and blooms into a sage success block with a drawn check, or re-expands as a butter error block that shakes and doubles as retry. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add CommitButton`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/CommitButton.json
- [Elastic Button](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/controls/elastic-button): A ButtonStyle that squashes toward the touch point, stretches with rubber-band resistance when dragged, deepens after a hold and snaps back with a spring. Optional solid surfaces (signal, block, raised) press into their own soft shadow and darken under the finger. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ElasticButton`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ElasticButton.json
- [Fan Stack](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/controls/fan-stack): Overlapping block-color avatars that fan apart on tap or hold with staggered springs, dissolve the +N pill into the hidden faces, and let a drag scrub across them: the avatar under the finger lifts, shows a name tag and ticks a haptic, and releasing selects it. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add FanStack`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/FanStack.json
- [Hold To Confirm](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/controls/hold-to-confirm): A press-and-hold capsule for destructive or important actions: a solid fill sweeps from the leading puck while held, passes three milestone dots with rising haptics, inverts the label under it, rewinds with a spring on early release and settles into a sage confirmed block. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add HoldToConfirm`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/HoldToConfirm.json
- [Timer Dial](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/controls/timer-dial): A countdown ring you set by dragging its knob around like the Timer dial, with a tick per step and a heavier detent every 5s. A solid block ring over a minute-tick scale, light display numerals, a breathing signal warning zone, a sage finish, and a determinate progress mode. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TimerDial`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TimerDial.json

## Data (https://swiftpieces.com/components/data)

- [Live Stat](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/data/live-stat): A metric tile with a light display-scale value that rolls with a spring and dims its decimals, a solid delta block, a sparkline you hold and scrub to retarget the value live, a press that expands the line into a taller chart with low and high, and a solid color block variant. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add LiveStat`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/LiveStat.json
- [Odometer](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/data/odometer): A number whose digits roll on individual slots like a mechanical counter, carrying from the low digits up so unchanged digits never move, with softened slot edges while rolling, dimmed decimals, a separate sign, a solid delta block, and a dashed loading state. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add Odometer`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/Odometer.json
- [Ring Breakdown](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/data/ring-breakdown): A composition ring of solid color blocks with rounded seams that you scrub by dragging around it, with a haptic at each slice boundary, a radial lift for the selected slice while the rest step back to the surface, a light display-scale center figure, and legend rows that turn into the slice's block. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add RingBreakdown`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/RingBreakdown.json
- [Scrub Chart](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/data/scrub-chart): A line or bar chart component with a light display-scale readout and dimmed decimals, a solid delta block, a flag that rides the scrub rule, hold-and-drag range selection with delta and percent, and a block range picker that morphs the line between datasets. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ScrubChart`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ScrubChart.json

## Feedback (https://swiftpieces.com/components/feedback)

- [Outcome Screen](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/feedback/outcome-screen): A success, failure or empty outcome view sharing one choreography, where a ring draws, floods into a solid color block, the mark strokes in dark ink, one pulse lands with a haptic, and a heavy headline and a single signal action rise, with async retry and a details block for failures. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add OutcomeScreen`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/OutcomeScreen.json
- [Rating Scrub](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/feedback/rating-scrub): A star rating you tap or scrub, with soft rounded stars that fill as solid blocks colored by the score, the star under your finger lifting, a staggered spring settle, and a light numeral with a label chip that morph as you go. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add RatingScrub`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/RatingScrub.json
- [Reaction Toggle](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/feedback/reaction-toggle): A like or save toggle that presses in, floods its capsule with a solid color block from the symbol outward, bounces the symbol, sends out one fading halo, and can roll a count or float a confirmation pill. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ReactionToggle`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ReactionToggle.json
- [Skeleton Loader](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/feedback/skeleton-loader): Solid placeholder bones and a self-masking modifier that turns any layout, color blocks included, into one quiet shape sweeping a soft diagonal highlight on a shared clock, then hands off as content unblurs and rises row by row. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SkeletonLoader`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SkeletonLoader.json
- [Status Morph](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/feedback/status-morph): One continuous stroke that spins as a loading arc, closes into a ring, floods into a solid block and draws a check in dark ink on success, or a cross with a nudge on failure, with an optional morphing caption. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add StatusMorph`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/StatusMorph.json

## Glass (https://swiftpieces.com/components/glass)

- [Glass Action Menu](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/glass/glass-action-menu): A floating signal trigger that long-presses open into a staggered line or arc of color-block actions you can slide across and release to fire; the trigger confirms with a check, tap toggles, a scrim dismisses, and the glass morphs on iOS 26. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassActionMenu`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassActionMenu.json
- [Glass Segments](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/glass/glass-segments): A segmented control whose glass indicator you can grab and drag: it lifts under the finger, rubber-bands past the ends, stretches with velocity and settles with a spring, while the label ink flips exactly under its edge; tap still works. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassSegments`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassSegments.json
- [Glass Surface](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/glass/glass-surface): The Glass family foundation: Liquid Glass in a capsule, rect, circle or concentric shape on iOS 26, with a layered Material fallback that keeps the press response, solid tint, specular edge and a designed disabled state everywhere else. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassSurface`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassSurface.json

## Inputs (https://swiftpieces.com/components/inputs)

- [Amount Field](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/amount-field): A currency amount entry that formats live in the user's locale as each digit lands (grouping, decimal separator, symbol before or after, the currency's own fraction digits), with a large auto-fitting figure whose digits roll in, a blinking caret right after the digits, robust paste of amounts like "$1,234.56" or "1 234,56 €", and a limit that refuses the keystroke with a damped shake, an error haptic and a message line, all backed by a `Decimal` binding. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add AmountField`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/AmountField.json
- [Date Range Picker](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/date-range-picker): A start-to-end date range picker on a paged month grid built from the environment calendar and locale, where the first tap drops a solid butter start block, the second closes the range and a soft band sweeps day by day between the two blocks, wrapping across week rows with rounded caps, while sold-out days are struck through, a maximum length dims unreachable days, months page by swipe or chevrons with a rolling title, and a summary reads out the dates and nights. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add DateRangePicker`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/DateRangePicker.json
- [Expanding Track](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/expanding-track): A thumbless slider drawn as a solid color bar that swells from 8pt to a 32pt block under the finger, shows detent dots and an inverting readout while dragging, squishes past either end, and can carry an uppercase label with a big light numeral; a second init selects a range with two sinking handles. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ExpandingTrack`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ExpandingTrack.json
- [Filter Rail](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/filter-rail): A scrolling rail of filter chips with optional counts where one solid indicator glides between single-select picks, multi-select picks light up as color blocks with dark ink and gather at the leading edge behind a counting Clear chip, the chosen chip scrolls into view, and edges fade only when content overflows. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add FilterRail`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/FilterRail.json
- [Form Field](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/form-field): A text field on a soft 56pt block whose label rests inside as a placeholder and glides up into a caption on focus or once filled, with an optional leading icon, a clear button, help text, a grapheme-accurate character limit with a counter that turns into a tangerine chip and bumps when extra input is refused, and validation that waits until you leave the field before drawing an error ring, sliding in the message with an error haptic and a VoiceOver announcement, then shows a sage check once fixed. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add FormField`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/FormField.json
- [Range Slider](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/range-slider): A dual-thumb slider for a range of values, with two round thumbs on a quiet track and the selected span drawn as a solid color block between them; drag either thumb or touch the track to pull the nearest one over, values snap to a step without floating drift, the thumbs never cross and keep a minimum gap, a grabbed thumb grows and its readout chip fills with the block color, the two readouts merge into one chip instead of colliding, and every step ticks a selection haptic with a firmer impact at a bound or the gap. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add RangeSlider`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/RangeSlider.json
- [Scrub Stepper](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/scrub-stepper): A capsule stepper with round minus and plus buttons around a solid numeral block; tap, hold to repeat with acceleration, or scrub sideways across the block for velocity-scaled steps while a ruler slides under the finger, and the capsule rubber-bands at the bounds. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ScrubStepper`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ScrubStepper.json
- [Secure Entry](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/secure-entry): A password field on a soft 56pt block with a focus ring and a round reveal toggle that keeps focus, a strength bar that grows through four color blocks with a matching label chip, requirement chips that turn into solid blocks with drawn checks and collapse when complete, a success check, and a damped shake with an error chip. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SecureEntry`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SecureEntry.json
- [Token Field](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/inputs/token-field): A tag and recipient field where committed entries become solid color chips with dark ink that wrap across lines while the text field takes the rest of the last line, return, comma or a paste of a whole list commits trimmed tokens with duplicate, limit and validation checks, backspace on an empty field highlights the last chip and a second press removes it, and an inline suggestion list filters as you type. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TokenField`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TokenField.json

## Lists (https://swiftpieces.com/components/lists)

- [Depth Carousel](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/depth-carousel): Paged cards that recede in depth as they leave center and hand each page a phase value for inner parallax. Neighbors come forward on tap, and a page counter sits beside a scrubbable pill indicator computed in absolute page coordinates so it never jumps. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add DepthCarousel`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/DepthCarousel.json
- [Paged List](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/paged-list): An async/await infinite-scroll list that prefetches the next page a few rows before the end, never runs two loads at once, drops duplicate ids across pages, ignores stale responses after a refresh or cancel, shows pulsing skeleton rows, a footer spinner, an inline "Couldn't load more" chip with a solid Retry block that keeps loaded rows, a quiet "You're all caught up" footer, and pull to refresh that replaces rows only on success. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add PagedList`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/PagedList.json
- [Status Timeline](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/status-timeline): A vertical status timeline where the live step becomes a solid color block, connectors draw in as steps complete, nodes morph from number to check, the current node breathes, and any step expands to show its detail. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add StatusTimeline`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/StatusTimeline.json
- [Swipe Action Row](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/swipe-action-row): Wraps any row in a soft card with swipe actions drawn as solid color blocks. Tiles grow in as the row opens, the drag rubber-bands, a full swipe arms with a haptic and lets the edge block take the whole bar, and a shared binding keeps one row open at a time. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add SwipeActionRow`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/SwipeActionRow.json
- [Task Row](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/lists/task-row): A task card whose check draws itself while the card flashes into a solid color block, a priority label block, a swipe-right that completes with a strike-through then compacts the row, swipe-left snooze and delete blocks, and a long-press lift that reports reorder moves. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TaskRow`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TaskRow.json

## Media (https://swiftpieces.com/components/media)

- [Photo Viewer](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/media/photo-viewer): A full-screen photo surface with anchor-correct pinch zoom, momentum panning that decelerates into the bounds, double-tap zoom about the tap, paging between images, and pinch-out or drag-down to dismiss with a fading scrim. A close button and a page counter that turns into a live zoom readout float above, and a single tap hides them. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add PhotoViewer`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/PhotoViewer.json
- [Story Strip](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/media/story-strip): A Stories-style segment strip with a built-in clock that advances segments on a duration, a long-press hold that freezes the strip and shows a paused badge, tap zones for back and forward that answer with a chevron, and a manual progress mode when you own the timing. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add StoryStrip`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/StoryStrip.json

## Motion (https://swiftpieces.com/components/motion)

- [Drag to Dismiss](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/motion/drag-to-dismiss): A modifier that lets a photo, card, or sheet follow a two-axis drag, rounds and shrinks it with progress over a styled scrim, reports its phase so the UI can say "release to close", then springs back or flies off along the drag vector past a distance or velocity threshold. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add DragToDismiss`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/DragToDismiss.json

## Navigation (https://swiftpieces.com/components/navigation)

- [Floating Dock](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/navigation/floating-dock): A floating dock on a solid surface where the selected item becomes a color block with its label, a drag across the dock lifts each item under the finger with a name bubble and commits on release, badges count in a signal pill, and the whole dock tucks away on scroll. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add FloatingDock`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/FloatingDock.json
- [Stretch Header](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/navigation/stretch-header): A hero header for your own ScrollView and NavigationStack: a heavy display title and uppercase eyebrow over a solid block hero that stretches on overscroll, a title that shrinks toward the real navigation bar, a stat row that pins under the bar, and a solid bar that fades in. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add StretchHeader`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/StretchHeader.json
- [Tracking Tabs](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/navigation/tracking-tabs): Tabs over a paging ScrollView whose solid block indicator follows the pages through fractional scroll progress, with ink titles that fade in as the block passes, optional counts, a pressed state, and a selection tick on settle. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TrackingTabs`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TrackingTabs.json

## Sheets (https://swiftpieces.com/components/sheets)

- [Confirm Sheet](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/sheets/confirm-sheet): A confirmation card that presents as a height-fitted bottom sheet or, inline, as a floating card you can drag away, with a solid icon tile that bounces on present, a heavy headline, a loading primary action that lands on a success check before dismissing, and a warning haptic for destructive choices. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ConfirmSheet`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ConfirmSheet.json
- [Permission Sheet](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/sheets/permission-sheet): A pre-permission sheet with a solid icon tile that bounces on present and turns into a check when granted, a heavy left-aligned headline, benefit rows on their own color tiles that stagger in, a signal-colored request button that spins while the system asks, and a denied result that swaps the copy and routes the button to Settings. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add PermissionSheet`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/PermissionSheet.json
- [Toast](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/sheets/toast): A single toast card with a solid color tile for its kind, a bold message with an optional detail line, a signal-colored action such as Undo, and a thin timer that pauses while touched; placed inside the safe area so it clears the Dynamic Island and rides above the keyboard. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add Toast`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/Toast.json

## Text (https://swiftpieces.com/components/text)

- [Expandable Text](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/text/expandable-text): A paragraph clamped to a line limit that measures whether it is really truncated, and only then fades the end of its last line into a trailing "more" link; tapping grows the block smoothly to its full height with no reflow, a "less" link collapses it, links stay tappable, and VoiceOver always reads the whole text. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add ExpandableText`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/ExpandableText.json
- [Glass Text](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/text/glass-text): Liquid Glass rendered on the actual glyph outlines of a string, one or several lines, with a specular Material fallback below iOS 26, a solid fill under Reduce Transparency and Dynamic Type scaling. (iOS 17.0+, Liquid Glass). Install: `npx swiftpieces add GlassText`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/GlassText.json
- [Text Reveal](https://swiftpieces.com/docs/components/text/text-reveal): Reveals a headline by characters, words or lines, rising from a baseline mask with a stagger sized to land in under a second, then wipes solid highlight blocks behind the phrases that matter. (iOS 17.0+). Install: `npx swiftpieces add TextReveal`. Registry: https://swiftpieces.com/r/TextReveal.json
